participantFlowModule.preAssignmentDetails: A total of 499 participants were screened, out of which 296 participants were enrolled and randomized to 1 of the 4 treatment groups.
participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails: The study was conducted from 12-March-2018 to 7-August-2019. Participants were screened at 70 centers across 8 countries, out of which 68 centers randomized at least 1 participant.

baselineCharacteristicsModule.populationDescription: Analysis was performed on randomized population that included any participant who had signed informed consent and had been allocated to a randomized treatment regardless of whether the treatment kit was used.
